name: Mordal
description: Mordal was a terrestrial world situated in the Illisurevimurasi sector's Mordal system of the Outer Rim Territories and the New Territories. During the Galactic Civil War in 4 ABY, the Galactic Empire and the Rebel Alliance fought a battle on Mordal. The civilian Corwin Ballast became trapped between the warring sides with his wife, Lynnta, and their daughter. The latter two perished from indiscriminate blaster fire.
